# proxmox_sdn_vnets (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN VNets from `/cluster/sdn/vnets`, sorted by `vnet`. `state` and `pending` show what is still uncommitted, so a forgotten `proxmox_sdn_apply` stays visible.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "proxmox_sdn_vnets" "app" {
  zone = "vz1"
}

output "app_vnets" {
  value = [for vnet in data.proxmox_sdn_vnets.app.vnets : vnet.vnet]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `zone` (String) Restrict the result to one zone. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `vnets` (Attributes List) Matching VNets, sorted by `vnet`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vnets))

<a id="nestedatt--vnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vnets`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) Alias, when set.
- `pending` (Map of String) Staged properties with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Staging state: `new` or `changed`.
- `tag` (Number) VLAN tag or VNI, when set.
- `vlanaware` (Boolean) Whether VLANs may pass through.
- `vnet` (String) VNet identifier.
- `zone` (String) Parent zone.
